text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was out and about with Shinko Windy today, but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...As an evil mastermind, I've become pretty decent.
That's what Windy-chan thinks, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Still, that whole vibe of having minions around you, like... a Big Shot?!!
It feels like I'm still kinda missing th—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: !!!! What on earth is that?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closer... a festival float was parked at the
edge of the street, as if in preparation for an upcoming festival.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That... That's it, nododa!!
That is exactly what Windy-chan needs, nododa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If I steal something that big and flashy
and make it Windy-chan's...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely become a big deal!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, minion!
Go steal that festival float at once!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since stealing the festival float wasn't an option,
I decided to ask the shopping district folks
if we could help carry it for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That's a huge help!
We were short on shrine-bearers and in quite a pinch~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Come on, the festival's about to start!
Hold that side, grab it!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text: Heave, hooo~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: W-Why are we carrying it together~~?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I told you to steal it!
Good grief, this is why I can't leave things to my underlings—

text_block_list.name: Night Owl Buono
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~! The one you just defeated was merely one of my henchmen~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(That's it! It's just like how that show went!
First the henchman goes down, and after that—)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The evil mastermind makes a cool entrance!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah!
We're on the main street! Shout it at the top of your lungs!"
Haaaaaltーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan has arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You might've defeated my minion... but the boss won't go down that easily!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Toh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Shinko Windy
leaped right onto the festival float!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've taken over!
Full speed ahead, I say!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
Oho, now a rider is joining in on the fly?!
Nice, this year's festival is gonna be wild!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text: This year's festival float is so lively and fun!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
Did you see that!? The great Windy-chan in action!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hijacking the festival float
and ruling over everyone with terror!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I did a super evil boss-worthy job!
choice_data_list: No one could take their eyes off you.
No one could take their eyes off you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Everyone was watching Windy-chan... It was the best ever, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You did great too, Minion! You totally nailed looking weak and desperate!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you busting your tail out there,
Windy-chan got to steal the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Keep doing your best for the Boss
from here on out, okay!"
choice_data_list: Doesn't doing something good make you feel better...?
As your underling, I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
That response of yours really comes naturally now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I knew it, a good-sounding minion's voice is absolutely essential for an evil organization!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do vocal warm-ups on the way back!
Follow the Boss!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Letting out villainous evil laughs,
the two of them made their way home.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
? What are you saying?
Committing villainy like this feels way better!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out, Windy-chan will just
keep charging down the path of evil!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Make sure you keep up with me properly, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She seems to think what she did this time was evil too.
I resolved to keep supporting her going forward, as I couldn't take my eyes off her in more ways than one."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Looks like you've finally gained
some self-awareness as my lackey, *noda*!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is also the fruit of Boss's teachings!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, shower Windy-chan with
even more praise and adulation!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since that's what was said, as her henchman,
I shall continue supporting the boss going forward.
